about_description: {{app}} is a game with influences from both Wordle and Trivial Pursuit. Guess the hidden word. Every word belongs to a category, and you are told which one. Play in Swedish, English or French. Play on your own or challenge others.
auth_error_send_link: Error sending sign-in link; check console for details.
challenge_completed_msg: Great job! You finished the challenge.
challenge_done_msg: Once a challenge is done you can not replay that challenge.
challenge_forfeited_msg: You gave up. Better luck next time!
check_back_tomorrow: A new challenge opens every Monday.
check_email_confirmation: Registration successful! We've sent a confirmation link to your email. Please check your inbox (and spam folder).
comp_feat_1: A new set of five words every week, theme revealed as you play
competitive_desc: Five words a week, drawn from a theme you don't see until you start. Knowing the subject counts, and so does not dawdling.

confirm_delete_account_msg_guest: This will permanently delete your guest account and everything on it — your name, avatar, scores and duels. There is no email or password to recover it with. This cannot be undone.
confirm_delete_score_msg: Are you sure you want to delete this score? This cannot be undone.
confirm_forfeit_msg: The challenge will be marked as forfeited and you will return to practice mode.
confirm_give_up_msg: You'll forfeit this challenge and won't be able to retry it.
confirm_give_up_practice_msg: The correct answer will be shown.
confirm_leave_msg: Leaving will forfeit the match. Are you sure?
confirm_publish_msg: This score will be visible on the global leaderboard.
confirm_sign_out_everywhere_msg: This signs you out on every device, including this one. You'll need to log in again. Your account and data are not affected.
confirm_skip_msg: You will get 0 points for this word, but can continue the challenge.
confirm_surrender_msg: Are you sure you want to give up? The other player will be declared the winner.
confirm_unpublish_msg: This score will differ from the global leaderboard.
data_erasure_pointer: To delete your account and all of this data, use the Danger Zone below.
data_privacy_body: Download everything we hold about you — your account, profile, scores, challenge history and duels — as a JSON file.
delete_account_backups_note: Deleted data may persist briefly in encrypted database backups before those expire on their normal schedule.
delete_account_description: Permanently delete your account and all related data — profile, scores, challenge history, and duel matches. This cannot be undone.
delete_account_description_guest: Permanently delete your guest account and everything on it — your name, avatar, scores and duels. A guest account has no email or password, so there is no way to recover it or sign in again afterwards.
delete_account_email_fallback: If you can't sign in, email us from the address registered to the account and we'll delete it for you. We answer within one month.
delete_account_guest_note: A guest account has no email or password, so it can't be recovered afterwards — and it can't be signed into from another device even now. If you'd rather keep your scores, sign up instead: that turns this same account into a full one, with everything intact.
delete_account_login_cta: Log in to delete your account
delete_account_page_intro: You can delete your Wordlune account and everything attached to it at any time. This cannot be undone.
delete_account_signed_out: Sign in and come back to this page, or use Settings → Danger Zone in the app. Deleting takes effect immediately.
delete_account_what_2: Your profile — display name, avatar and settings
delete_account_what_3: All your scores and practice history
delete_scores_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete these scores? This cannot be undone.
duel_description: Race another player to the same hidden word in real time. You both get the same category — after that it is whoever gets there first.
duel_feat_1: Real-time 1v1 — both players guess the same secret word at once
duel_feat_2: Scored by correct and present letters as you type
duel_feat_3: Open to Guests and Registered players alike
duel_opponent_prestart_exit: Opponent left before the duel started. No winner declared.
duel_opponent_surrendered: Your opponent has left the duel. You win!
duel_opponent_won: Your opponent found the word first!

practice_desc: Choose the subjects you want — animals, geography, food — and play at your own pace. Nothing is ranked and nothing is published.
practice_feat_1: Pick the subjects you want to be tested on
practice_feat_3: Scores are saved to your personal history (requires login)
privacy_policy_accept_label: I have read and accept the Privacy Policy
privacy_policy_accept_required: Please confirm you have read the Privacy Policy
privacy_policy_age_label: I am {{age}} years old or older
privacy_policy_age_required: You must be at least {{age}} to create an account
privacy_policy_changes_body: If this policy changes in a way that matters, we'll update the date at the top and let you know in the app the next time you sign in.
privacy_policy_children_body: Wordlune is not aimed at young children, and you must be at least {{age}} to create an account. If you believe a child has created one, contact us and we will remove it.
privacy_policy_controller_body: Wordlune is run by {{controller}}, a sole trader based in Sweden, who is the data controller for the processing described here.
privacy_policy_cookies_body: Wordlune sets no cookies and uses no tracking scripts. It stores your login session and preferences on your own device, which is necessary for the app to work and is why you are not asked to consent to it.
privacy_policy_data_account_basis: Performance of a contract (Art. 6(1)(b)) — we cannot give you an account without it.
privacy_policy_data_account_body: Your email address, an encrypted form of your password, the display name and avatar you chose at signup, and sign-in timestamps. Guest accounts have no email address.
privacy_policy_data_device_basis: Strictly necessary to provide the service you asked for.
privacy_policy_data_device_body: Your login session (which includes your email address), any round you have in progress, and your theme, language and reduced-motion preferences. Logging out erases the session and the round in progress; deleting your account erases all of it.
privacy_policy_data_duel_basis: Performance of a contract (Art. 6(1)(b)) — a duel cannot work without both players knowing who they are playing.
privacy_policy_data_duel_body: For each duel, which two players took part, which word was played, and who won. Your opponent sees your display name and avatar during the duel.
privacy_policy_data_gameplay_basis: Performance of a contract (Art. 6(1)(b)) — this is the game history the app exists to keep.
privacy_policy_data_gameplay_body: Your scores, the words you played, how many guesses you used, how long each round took, the language you played in, and your progress through challenges.
privacy_policy_data_intro: Each of these is kept only for as long as described under “How long we keep it” below.
privacy_policy_data_profile_basis: Performance of a contract (Art. 6(1)(b)), except leaderboard visibility, which is consent (Art. 6(1)(a)) and can be withdrawn at any time.
privacy_policy_data_profile_body: Your display name, avatar, level, and whether you have chosen to make your profile visible on leaderboards.
privacy_policy_data_settings_body: Your chosen theme, language, and reduced-motion preference.
privacy_policy_data_technical_basis: Legitimate interests (Art. 6(1)(f)) — keeping the service available and secure.
privacy_policy_data_technical_body: Your IP address and basic request information are handled in passing by our hosting and network providers in order to deliver the app and to protect it from abuse. We do not build profiles from this.
privacy_policy_intro: This explains what Wordlune does with your personal data, why, and what you can ask us to do about it. Wordlune has no advertising, no analytics, and no tracking of any kind.
privacy_policy_leaderboard_body: Nothing appears on a public leaderboard unless you choose to publish it. Publishing a score shows your display name, your avatar and that score to anyone signed in to Wordlune.
privacy_policy_leaderboard_withdraw: You can unpublish a score, or make your profile private again, at any time — that removes it from the leaderboards going forward.
privacy_policy_recipient_cloudflare: Cloudflare — delivers the website and terminates the encrypted connection.
privacy_policy_recipient_github: GitHub — stores the built application image. Receives no player data.
privacy_policy_recipient_google: Google Play — distributes the Android app. Applies only if you installed it from the Play Store.
privacy_policy_recipient_resend: Resend — sends the account emails described above; receives your email address and display name.
privacy_policy_recipient_supabase: Supabase — hosts the database, accounts, and real-time duel connections. Your data is stored in Stockholm, Sweden (EU).
privacy_policy_recipients_intro: We do not sell your data and we do not share it for anyone else's purposes. We do rely on these providers to run the service, each bound by a data processing agreement:
privacy_policy_retention_backups: Deleted data may persist briefly in encrypted database backups before those expire.
privacy_policy_retention_guest: Guest accounts are deleted automatically after 14 days without being used.
privacy_policy_retention_inactive: If you don't sign in for 6 months, we email you a warning. If you still haven't signed in 14 days later, the account and its data are deleted.
privacy_policy_retention_self_delete: You can delete your account yourself at any time, which removes your profile, scores, challenge history and duels immediately.
privacy_policy_retention_unverified: If you sign up but never confirm your email address, the account is deleted after 14 days.
privacy_policy_right_access: Access — get a copy of your data. Settings → Data & Privacy → Download my data.
privacy_policy_right_erasure: Erasure — delete your account and everything attached to it. Settings → Danger Zone.
privacy_policy_right_portability: Portability — the download above is machine-readable JSON you can take elsewhere.
privacy_policy_right_rectification: Rectification — correct anything wrong. Settings → edit your profile.
privacy_policy_right_restriction: Restriction and objection — ask us to pause or stop a particular use of your data.
privacy_policy_right_withdraw: Withdraw consent — turn leaderboard visibility off at any time, in Settings or per score.
privacy_policy_rights_complaint: If you think we've handled your data wrongly, you have the right to complain to the Swedish Authority for Privacy Protection (IMY, imy.se).
privacy_policy_rights_howto: For anything you can't do in the app, or if you want help, write to
privacy_policy_rights_response: We answer requests within one month.
privacy_policy_security_body: All traffic is encrypted in transit. Passwords are stored only as salted hashes, never in readable form. Access to the database is restricted so that each account can only reach its own data.
privacy_policy_transfers_body: Your database and its backups are stored in Stockholm, Sweden. Supabase, which operates it, also engages sub-processors outside the EU for hosting, monitoring, security and support, and some of these can in principle access data held in the service; Supabase publishes a current list of them. Resend, which sends the account emails described above, is based in the United States, and Cloudflare routes web traffic through a global network. All of these transfers are covered by the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses.
ranked_games_description: Games that count towards the leaderboard.
reg_desc_8: Can delete your account and all its data anytime
reset_password_email_sent: If an account exists for that email, a password reset link has been sent.
reset_password_instructions: Enter your email above, then send yourself a reset link.
reset_password_new_prompt: Choose a new password for your account.
sessions_body: Signing out only affects the device you're using. If you've lost a device, or think someone else has access to your account, sign out everywhere — this signs you out here too.
settings_guest_note: Settings are saved to your browser unless you sign up and log in.
sign_out_everywhere_unconfirmed: You've been signed out on this device, but we couldn't confirm the others. Check your connection and try again.
sudden_death_msg: Opponent failed to find the word! You have 60 seconds to find it and win!
upgrade_check_email: Almost there! We've sent a confirmation link to your email — click it to finish turning this into a full account. Your scores and history are already safe, and you can keep playing in the meantime.
upgrade_guest_notice: You're playing as a guest. Signing up keeps everything you've already done — your scores, duels and history all carry over to the new account.
username_too_long: Display name must be {{length}} chars or less
visitor_competitive_warning: Log in to play competitive mode!
visitor_duel_warning: Please log in to play Duel mode!
visitor_save_warning: Please log in to save your score.
waiting_for_player_accept: Your challenge is live. Waiting for someone to accept.
welcome_subtitle: Every round is drawn from a category — animals, capital cities, groceries, countries. The letters narrow the field; what you know closes it. Three languages, alone or against someone.
welcome_title: Guess the Word. Know the Subject.
word_solved_msg: Congratulations on one word correctly set
zero_score_brag_message: You actually want to publish a ZERO score? Bragging about failure is a bold strategy. Are you sure?
score_not_solved_detail: No points are awarded for a word you miss, skip or give up.
score_legacy_note: This score was saved before the time bonus existed, so it was capped at {{max}}. The rules below are how it would be scored today.
score_aggregate_note: A challenge score is the sum of the score for each word in it. Only the totals are stored, so the words cannot be broken out individually.
scoring_rules_intro: Practice and challenge words are scored the same way, out of a maximum of {{max}} points per word.
scoring_rule_guess: Solving a word gives {{base}} points, minus {{step}} for every guess after the first — so {{base}} on the first guess down to {{floor}} on the sixth.
scoring_rule_time: On top of that comes a time bonus of up to {{bonus}} points.
scoring_rule_free_time: You get {{perLetter}} seconds of free thinking time per letter — 50 seconds for a five-letter word — and the bonus only starts to drop after that.
scoring_rule_decay: Past the free time you lose one point of bonus every two seconds, down to zero.
scoring_rule_lost: A word you miss, skip or give up scores nothing at all.
scoring_rule_duel: Duel is scored differently: {{correct}} points for every letter in the right place and {{present}} for every letter that is in the word but misplaced, counted as you guess.
challenge_replay_msg: Your progress on this challenge will be reset. Only your first run counts towards the leaderboard, so this is just for fun.
challenge_replay_failed_msg: This challenge is no longer open.
practice_always_private: Practice is always private. These rounds are never published and never appear on any leaderboard.
competitive_private_hint: Only you can see these. Use the toggle to publish a result to the list beside it.
competitive_public_hint: Published results only, and only each player's first run of a challenge.
duel_private_hint: Only you can see these. Individual duels are never published.
duel_public_hint: Ranked by difference — wins minus losses. Players with a public profile only; set yours in Settings.
duel_won_inactivity: Your opponent stopped playing. You win.
duel_lost_inactivity: You ran out of time to guess. Your opponent wins.
duel_won_timeout: Time ran out. You were closest to the word, so you win.
duel_lost_timeout: Time ran out. Your opponent was closer to the word.
duel_abandoned_msg: Neither player made a guess, so the duel was called off. It counts for neither of you.
invite_expired_msg: Nobody new can find this challenge now. Cancel and create a new one — or wait a moment longer, in case someone already had it open.
